Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Marie Zéphyrine’s paternal grandmother was Louis XV’s mother, Marie Adélaïde of Savoy—confusing the paternal grandmother (father’s mother) with the paternal great-grandmother. This misstep likely arose from misinterpreting a disambiguation page and shifting focus to Louis XV’s parentage rather than identifying the mother of Louis, Dauphin of France (i.e., Marie Leszczyńska).
